canonical.commands: init --auth passphrase, an appended `mcp:` section in config.yaml, then `mcp --port 0`
canonical.garbage: {vault}/garbage.pem contains the single line `not a pem`
canonical.paths: the fixture certificate directory is {certs}, the throw-away vault directory is {vault}

scope.compared: exit code, stdout (empty) and every line of stderr that starts with `Error: `
scope.not_compared: stderr lines before the failing check: `MCP server listening on ...` and the legacy-token migration warning (random token id), the cleartext prompt
scope.ordering: Go binds the listener and migrates the token registry before it validates the client CA and key pair; the Rust server validates first and so prints none of those lines and leaves no token registry behind
scope.plain_tls: non-mTLS certificate/key failures surface Go crypto/tls library text (open ...: no such file or directory, tls: failed to find any PEM data) and are not frozen here
scope.windows: recorded texts are the Unix errno texts; the Rust replay is unix-only
